revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template webtoon-shot-v1. 1536x2048 pixels with 6% safe margin. Extreme close-up, top-down angle, normal lens feel. Camera positioned between Theo’s fingertips and the falling crumbs, with a subtle tilt movement. Focus on the boundary where white bread crumbs break down into fine cool gray ash. Leave a long empty upper space to build anticipation for the scene below.

Subject: Theo Waldhart only, using reference 1 strictly for character identity. Show only a small child’s hand entering from the lower-left area, around left 9%, top 67%, width 42%, height 25%, foreground. Preserve: small child hand, blue-gray sleeve cuff, no face visible. Action: the hand has just released crumbs, and the crumbs drift upward and outward into ash as the current dining table memory fades away.

Background: use reference 2 strictly for background-space inspiration. Arken-fall-memory transition: an ivory-gray paper-like void emphasizing vertical fall, abstract top-down memory space. Use the feeling of a cropped memory transition from crumbs to ash, not literal panel layout. Depth layers: small hand, scattering crumbs and ash, paper-toned memory void. Lighting is cold, flat gray, no sunbeams.

Visual treatment: only the ash particles are rendered with delicate fine line detail; everything else restrained and minimal. Color transitions from soft white crumbs to cold charcoal gray ash. Clean 2D disintegration effect, quiet falling mood, no magic symbols, no explosions.

Continuity: Theo was looking at the crumbs; now the crumbs fully become ash and the present tabletop disappears. Neutral screen direction. Keep a quiet negative space in upper-left region for lettering, but generate no speech balloons, captions, or readable text.

Avoid: speech bubbles, captions, readable text, watermark, signature, duplicate character, flames, magic circles, adult face, any readable letters.
